body.name: Lag-robust intrinsic-district handle
body.construction: Adapt the possible-c-component region recursion of Jaber--Ribeiro--Zhang--Bareinboim and the intrinsic-set fixing operator of Richardson--Robins--Evans--Shpitser to \(\mathsf S(H,L,\mathcal A,X,Y,\gamma)\); augment each state by temporal-role offsets, instantaneous-order constraints, boundary bidirected connectivity, and a typed kernel identity over cylinders in \(\Omega_{\mathcal A}\), and use periodic hedge cutting as the finite-state pumping handle.
